owner: ZOKUZOKU / ぞくぞく, indie developer of the Cat Gatekeeper browser extension and desktop app (@konekone2026)
story: The star of Cat Gatekeeper, a free browser extension by Japanese developer ZOKUZOKU (@konekone2026). Spend too long on social media and a giant, chubby orange tabby strolls onto your screen, plops down in front of your feed and stays until the break timer runs out. At launch there was no way to shoo it away; a later update lets you dismiss it early by pressing and holding a button for about three seconds. The launch post on 26 Apr 2026 ("I made a kitty forced-break app! Use social media too much and the kitty appears and takes over your screen") went viral on X, and Dexerto covered it the same day. Digital Trends and Popular Science wrote about it soon after. The official site now reports over 300,000 users, plus a Firefox version and a desktop app. The cat has no official name; the creator just calls it "kitty" (猫ちゃん). The site says its cats are "ideal cats created with the help of AI".
look: A photo-realistic (AI-assisted) giant, very chubby orange/ginger mackerel tabby. Darker orange stripes run across the forehead, cheeks, flanks and legs. The chin, chest, belly and paws are white. Amber/olive-gold eyes, often sleepily half-closed, and a pink nose. It wears a dark grey collar with a small silver bell. A huge round belly: it slumps back on one hip with its belly out and a hind leg stretched forward,, filling the screen in front of the social feed.

owner: Matt Taghioff (London), who runs @CuriousZelda
story: Zelda was a black-and-white London rescue cat. Matt Taghioff adopted her from the Mayhew rescue shelter in 2014; at first she hid under the sofa, watching him with an unblinking stare and spooking at the slightest noise. As @CuriousZelda ('Hunter of house flies and keeper of string. Easily startled. Often caught staring. Author of book.') she won fans with her startled look and her rhyming posts, such as her 2023 rhyme 'Will Twitter be toast? / Has everyone fled? / It's high time I shared / A Thread about bread'. With more than 80,000 followers she won a book deal at auction: 'The Adventures of a Curious Cat' (Sphere, an imprint of Little, Brown, 2019). Zelda died peacefully at home in 2024. Matt's farewell post thanked fans for their poems, memes and fan art.
look: A black-and-white tuxedo cat. Her head, back, legs and tail are solid glossy black, with a neat white bib from throat to chest, white front paws and white toes on the hind feet. Huge round yellow-green eyes with big dark pupils give her a permanently startled, wide-eyed stare. Black nose, long white whiskers, upright black ears and a compact, loaf-shaped build; sometimes a tiny pink tongue blep. No accessories.
